name: Buckingham Foodbank
description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels and support. Located at Buckingham Centre. Open Mon
image: Fri for distribution. Referral required via local agencies.

name: Buckingham Town Allotments
description: Buckingham Town Council manages several allotment sites including Chandos Road and Bourton Road. Waiting lists operate for plots. Annual rent around £35-45. Contact town council for availability.
